title.id: Artikel baru: Kernel Linux Utuh di Browser: Belajar Koding Tanpa Sewa VPS
title.en: New article: A Real Linux Kernel in the Browser: Learning Code Without VPS Bills

body.id: Satu tulisan baru ditambahkan ke blog: "Kernel Linux Utuh di Browser: Belajar Koding Tanpa Sewa VPS". Tulisannya membahas kompilasi kernel linux ke webassembly membuka peluang baru untuk belajar sistem operasi langsung lewat peramban tanpa sewa server
body.en: A new article was added to the blog: "A Real Linux Kernel in the Browser: Learning Code Without VPS Bills". It covers compiling a genuine linux kernel to webassembly unlocks zero-cost operating system sandboxes right inside modern browser tabs
